environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in VPC subnet subnet-0a3f8c92d (10.4.128.0/24) with route table rtb-07e2a1b that contains only local route (10.4.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sts (vpce-0f8c3a21d). No igw or nat-gw attachment on the route table. Security group sg-0d4e7f2a1b has egress rules limited to prefix list pl-63a5400a (S3 gateway endpoint) and the STS VPC endpoint ENI (10.4.200.17/32 port 443). DNS resolution uses Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint with private hosted zone override for sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com pointing to the VPC endpoint. Task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111111111111:policy/FargateTaskBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole where aws:ResourceTag/sensitivity equals 'admin'. CloudWatch VPC endpoint present for logging only.
